title: Feather Nest Melody
hook: Spot the feather, say it clear!
Letter and bird are landing here!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: cozy 3D feathers-and-nests storybook, warm twig browns and egg pastels, friendly birds, simple isolated subjects

creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 uses birdwatching language—feather, beak, feet, perch, water or flight clues—and leaves long species names enough musical space.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses binocular-style cue-gap-answer timing followed by one wing, perch, beak or walking gesture; flightless birds get grounded motions.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: light flute/whistle feather answer kept separate from the sung target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: light flute/whistle feather answer kept separate from the sung target
